notes: Chance of moving: a ridge logistic regression on our own movement history (MLB Stats API transactions from October 2014 and who played where), refitted each season and validated on held-out seasons (Model page).

No contract data: salaries, contract years, options and no-trade clauses are not used, because no source whose terms allow our use has them. Free agency is inferred from age, years since the MLB debut (the service-time proxy: six years for free agency, three to five for arbitration), tenure with the club and role.
Value is Bullpen WAR, the last two seasons blended 3:2. Rostered: the last club the player played for this season, with no move off it since.

Outlook: the chance of adding at least one player at the position who was on another MLB club, by next season, from a Poisson model of past arrivals (need there, club strength and trajectory, turnover, expected departures). Prospects from the club's own system and signings from outside MLB are not counted.

Targets: players on other clubs who would upgrade the club's weakest regular slot at their position (the fifth starter, the seventh reliever, else the regular), ranked by their chance of joining it: the chance the player moves x the chance this club is where they go (a conditional logit on past moves: the upgrade, the need, contenders and veterans, rebuilders and youth, turnover, same league). An estimate from on-field value and history, not news.
